messages:
maya: saw a 7% bump in invoice-preview tokens for tenant `bluefox` right after we enabled the routing-fallback canary at 16:21 UTC. preview has duplicate lines with same req_id but different route_tag. anyone on metering?
ben: likely fanout duplication. do the events include `request_fingerprint`?
maya: inconsistent. proxy-v1 clients still lack fingerprint. ingest-bot raised a spike: `ingest.dedupe.missing_fp`.
ingest-bot: WARN ingest.consumer batch=2048 missing_fingerprint=987 canary=canary/2026-05-01T16:20Z
ben: quick options: 1) revert fanout to single-route cutover, 2) compute fallback fingerprint in consumer using req_id + tenant + ts_ms, 3) attach a canary flag and ignore preview duplicates while dedupe runs.
sre_kim: prefer (2) to avoid halting rollout. caveat: ts_ms is absent for many v1 clients -> risk false merges on retries.
maya: agreed. suggest fp fallback = req_id||'|'||tenant_id||'|'||coalesce(ts_ms, floor(ts_unix*1000))||'|'||coalesce(retry_hint,'0'). tag events with dedupe_provenance=fp-fallback-20260501.
ben: canary the change to 10% of consumer shards and monitor duplicate_token_rate. also add alert: page if duplicate_token_rate > 1% for 5m.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: metering-consumer/fp-fallback@canary shards=10% id=dc-20260501-16:30
maya: also, console asks: can we display a small preview-note for tenants when canary metadata present so finance doesn't start ticketing? simple transient banner: "Invoice preview may include duplicates during routing rollouts."
sre_kim: ok but make sure it does NOT appear on final invoice PDF; only preview UI. product will own wording.
ben: rolling patch looks good. i ran a quick query to find duplicates across route_tag for the 5-minute window:

```
SELECT req_id, tenant_id, COUNT(*) as cnt, SUM(tokens) as total_tokens
FROM metering.events
WHERE tenant_id='bluefox' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-05-01T16:18:00Z' AND '2026-05-01T16:26:00Z'
GROUP BY req_id, tenant_id
HAVING cnt > 1
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

ben: initial run showed 312 dup groups, median duplicated tokens=36, most had route_tag pair `canary-fallback` + `primary`.
maya: can you capture some sample req_ids for SDK triage? i'll paste them to the SDK team channel.
ben: pasted 20 sample req_ids. many map to older SDK versions.
sre_kim: after fp-fallback canary rolled out we saw duplicate_token_rate drop ~88% in sampled shards. small tail remains where neither ts_ms nor retry_hint present.
maya: open follow-ups: PLAT-7001 console preview banner, PLAT-7002 proxy-v1 emit ts_ms/fingerprint, PLAT-7003 product work for canonical request id.
ben: added PLAT-7001 to roadmap, i'll take it.
sre_kim: leaving alerting on for 2h and will mute billing-emails channel if preview banner quiets finance.
maya: thanks team, keeping this thread to track root cause and follow-ups. :thumbsup:
